}}'''Fionnda Annariz''' is a High Lady of [[Tear]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Fionnda Annariz}}

==Appearance==
She is pretty and has iron eyes.

==Activities==
She is one of the High Ladies sent to [[Cairhien]].

She is seen by [[Samitsu Tamagowa]] in close conversation with [[Alaine Chuliandred]] in the [[Sun Palace]]. This is strange as it shows the old animosities between the Tairen and Cairhienin nobility breaking down. Whether this is for good or ill remains to be seen.
